Class RawResponseFuture

java.lang.Object
java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<HttpResponse<?>>
io.micronaut.http.client.RawResponseFuture
All Implemented Interfaces:
CompletionStage<HttpResponse<?>>, Future<HttpResponse<?>>
@Internal public final class RawResponseFuture extends CompletableFuture<HttpResponse<?>>
The CompletableFuture of an AsyncRawHttpClient exchange. Cancelling it cancels the exchange, and a response that arrives after the future was cancelled is closed.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:

      public static RawResponseFuture of(ExecutionFlow<? extends HttpResponse<?>> flow, CloseableByteBody requestBody)
      The future of an exchange flow. Cancelling the future cancels the flow. The request body is closed when the flow completes or the future is cancelled.
